name: Redberry
description:
A plump-looking redberry.
Recovers 15% life and magi on pickup, as well as some tech.

name: Blueberries
description:
A bunch of juicy-looking blueberries.
Recovers 15% life on pickup, and more life/tech over time!

name: Blackberries
description:
A scrumptious bunch of blackberries.
Recovers 15% magi on pickup, and more magi/tech over time!

name: Banaberry
description:
You're pretty sure this is a banana, but the locals call it a banaberry.
Restores allies from the dead with 15% of their life and magi!

name: Serum
description:
Restores life to max and revives all dead members.
Made from the rarest of fae parts.

name: Ether
description:
Restores magi to max and purges all standard ailments.
Made from the rarest of gelatin bits.

name: Draught
description:
An elixir of sorts that regenerates over time by extracting electrons from the air to recompose itself.
Potent enough to revive the dead, but slaps your tool slot with a wildly long \C[1]five minute cooldown\C[0]; always a last resort!

name: Tiny Heartfruit
description:
A small heartfruit, though ambrosial, is barely ripe.
Heals 40% HP/MP and restores from dead- for the whole party!

name: Heartfruit
description:
A legendary ambrosial fruit, grown in the Gardens of Eden.
Heals all HP/MP and restores from dead- for the whole party!

name: Nectar
description:
The legendary heartfruit- grown in the Gardens of Eden- and obliterated into a beautiful puree of the heavens.
Heals all HP/MP and restores from dead- for the whole party!

name: Raw Rouge
description:
Unrefined rouge matter.
You'll need to refine it through alchemy if you want to use it.

name: Rouge Essence
description:
Refined rouge matter, radiating with the heat element.
Use in crafting of any type to add a touch of heat to things.

name: Pure Rouge
description:
Ultra-concentrated and refined rouge essence.
A few drops of this and anything you're crafting will radiate intense heat.

name: Raw Bleu
description:
Unrefined bleu matter.
You'll need to refine it through alchemy if you want to use it.

name: Bleu Essence
description:
Refined bleu matter, radiating with the liquid element.
Use in crafting of any type to add a splash of liquidity to things.

name: Pure Bleu
description:
Ultra-concentrated and refined bleu essence.
A few drops of this and anything you're crafting will become aqueous.

name: Raw Verte
description:
Unrefined verte matter.
You'll need to refine it through alchemy if you want to use it.

name: Verte Essence
description:
Refined verte matter, radiating with the air element.
Use in crafting of any type to improve the flow of things.

name: Pure Verte
description:
Ultra-concentrated and refined verte essence.
A few drops of this and anything you're crafting will be light as a feather.

name: Raw Jaune
description:
Unrefined jaune matter.
You'll need to refine it through alchemy if you want to use it.

name: Jaune Essence
description:
Refined jaune matter, radiating with the ground element.
Use in crafting of any type to add some grit to things.

name: Pure Jaune
description:
Ultra-concentrated and refined jaune essence.
A few drops of this and anything you're crafting will be solid as rock.

name: Raw Blanche
description:
Unrefined blanche matter.
You'll need to refine it through alchemy if you want to use it.

name: Blanche Essence
description:
Refined blanche matter, radiating with the energy element.
Use in crafting of any type to add a sense of absolute purity to things.

name: Pure Blanche
description:
Ultra-concentrated and refined blanche essence.
A few drops of this and anything you're crafting will become blessed.

name: Raw Noire
description:
Unrefined noire matter.
You'll need to refine it through alchemy if you want to use it.

name: Noire Essence
description:
Refined noire matter, radiating with the void element.
Use in crafting of any type to add that missing something to things.

name: Pure Noire
description:
Ultra-concentrated and refined noire essence.
A few drops of this and anything you're crafting will become cursed.

name: Iron Ore
description:
Raw iron ore- the core building blocks of most modern society.
It can be used as-is in some cases, but an \item[31] would be better.

name: Iron Ingot
description:
A boring ingot of iron ready to smith into something useful.
Can be forged into all sorts of things ranging from swords to guns to armor to circuitry.

name: Silver Ore
description:
Raw silver ore, which looks shiny even when raw.
Not much can be done with it in this state, do turn it into a \item[33].

name: Silver Ingot
description:
A gorgeous ingot of pure silver, which is surprisingly "soft" for metal.
Thanks to being highly conductive, its commonly found in electronics.

name: Bleu Ore
description:
Raw bleu ore, which actually doesn't look very blue at all.
It is however, moist, and should be turned into a \item[35] ASAP.

name: Bleu Ingot
description:
A solid and durable ingot made of pure bleu.
It always looks like you just pulled it out of a bucket of water for some reason.

name: Sandwraith Ore
description:
Raw sandwraith ore, which might just be sand.
You're not sure, but if you can turn it into \item[37], then it'll be more useful for sure.

name: Sandwraith Ingot
description:
An ingot made of pure sandwraith- which is just Very Sharp Sand.
Superb metal when used in blades and the like, cleaving other metals like a knife through butter.

name: Engle Ore
description:
Raw engle ore.
Just turn it into \item[39], because its useless like this otherwise.

name: Engle Ingot
description:
A pure Engle ingot.
What? Do you not know what "Engle" is? Because neither do I, so I hope its useful!

name: Deepe Ore
description:
Raw deepe ore- aptly named since you found it in the depths of The Subterranean.
More useful to mostly anyone as a \item[41], though.

name: Deepe Ingot
description:
A sturdy ingot made of pure Deepe.
Its spiritual conductivity make it great for magical stuff and things.

name: Ultanium Ore
description:
Raw ultanium ore- though one struggles to call such an orb "ore" at this point.
You definitely have no idea how to use this as-is, it need refining, somehow.

name: Ultanium Ingot
description:
The ultimate product of forging mastertude.
The durability is unbreakable, sharpness lethal, and weight basically none.

name: Oak
description:
This looks like a limb off of a plain ol' oak tree.
Can be manufactured into paper.

name: Basic Paper
description:
The standard in modern lumber, used since ancient times by all cultures.
Its versatility of use makes it extremely popular.

name: Dreamwood
description:
This looks like a limb off of a Dreamy Willow from the forest.
Can be manufactured into paper.

name: Lofty Sheet
description: A dreamy sheet of paper that makes you sigh with contentment.

name: Negapine
description:
This looks like a limb off of a Negapine Tree from the mountains.
Can be manufactured into paper.

name: Dense Vellum
description:
Heavy, thick, professional sheet of vellum.
The finest legalese nonsense can be written on here.

name: Grimwood
description:
This looks like a limb off of a Grimtooth Birch from the graveyard.
Can be manufactured into paper.

name: Grim Stock
description:
A dark and gloomy piece of paper, embossed with skulls and emo hearts.
Edgerr Alan Poe probably invented this for his edgy poetry.

name: Subwood
description:
This looks like a limb off of a Subterranean Banyan from... The Subterranean.
Can be manufactured into paper.

name: Sheer Papyrus
description:
A fantastic and broad sheet of expensive-looking tapestry.
It is almost quivering with excitement at the art to be rendered upon it.

name: Heartwood
description:
This looks like a limb off of an Hearty Dragontree from the plains.
Can be manufactured into paper.

name: Decadent Parchment
description:
A sumptuous and luxurious sheet of decadent paper.
It might actually be oozing with gold and diamonds, who is to say?

name: Digiwood
description:
This looks like a "limb" off of a Digital Holotree from... somewhere?
Can be manufactured into... some kind of paper, probably.

name: Holographic Viewer
description:
This isn't even paper at all, its a foldable digital screen.
It can likely be programmed or something maybe to show... stuff.

name: Ruby
description: A beautiful ruby with almost no imperfections.

name: Star Ruby
description:
An ultra-rare ruby bearing star-like molecule structure which
gives it a wildly different shape than a normal ruby in the wild.

name: Emerald
description: A sparkling emerald, shaped to be inlaid into other items.

name: Twist Emerald
description:
When emeralds are introduced to certain environmental factors, their
insides can twist and contort, creating an extremely durable emerald.

name: Topaz
description: A gorgeous topaz that glimmers a subtle yellow.

name: Imperial Topaz
description:
A topaz that can become a perfect sphere if deconstructed and
then reconstructed with a bit of alchemy.

name: Sapphire
description: A shimmering sapphire that is as blue as the sky.

name: Ethereal Sapphire
description:
An ethereal sapphire is insanely rare, with only a few left in the galaxy.
It radiates a mysterious aura and has taken on a bit of a different look.

name: Crystal
description: A generic crystalline gemstone. Quite durable.

name: Power Crystal
description:
Through careful fusion techniques, one can fuse two particular types
of crystal into a single crystal without increasing the mass.

name: Diamond
description: The king of gems, a diamond has both beauty AND endurance.

name: Rainbow Diamond
description:
Though blue at a glance, this diamond reflects all colors of
the rainbow depending on the angle and lighting.

name: Diode
description:
A standard diode typically used in building circuitry.
It doesn't look like anything special, but its the foundation of modern life.

name: Advanced Diode
description:
A highly advanced diode used in building very complex circuitry.
This is necessary to construct anything resembling digital intelligence.

name: Mobius Diode
description:
A cross-dimensional diode used in building mobius circuitry.
Without this, you'd have no hope of building forth the future of automation.

name: Crude Matrix
description:
The core of all cores, the standard storage and processor combo.
It can manipulate and drive electronics of all sorts.

name: Second Gen Matrix
description:
A second generation core, with exactly 12% improvements over the original.
You can use it to ... do everything you could for the first.

name: Acceleration Matrix
description:
A core that was specially designed for very fast processing.
Anything constructed using this would surely be very ...fast!

name: Alien Matrix
description:
It isn't clear what kind of core this is or how you made it.
Its alien, bro. Come on. Stop making alien shit like you know what to do with it.

name: Deific Matrix
description:
A core that glows and hums gently, as if singing you a lullaby.
You should probably get yourself checked if you hear it, because its emitting zero sonic waves.

name: Mobius Matrix
description:
In reality, this thing is pseudo-present.
It spends part of its time here, there, and everywhere, somehow, sometime, somewhere.

name: Bare Threads
description:
The most mediocre thread to ever exist.
Can be woven into fabric.

name: Plain Fabric
description:
Conventional everyday cloth used in everyday things.
Used for whipping up all sorts of things, ranging from capes to panties.

name: Durable Threads
description:
A highly durable ball of yarn, eager to be woven into something.
Can be woven into fabric.

name: Thick Fabric
description:
One would like to call this fabric, but its not.
It is just a glorified potato sack- a very durable one at that.

name: Silken Threads
description:
A soft and loose thread made of the fibers of a ridiculously soft plant.
Can be woven into fabric.

name: Airy Fabric
description:
So lightweight and elegant, one might believe this fabric is made of air.
The fact that it is transparent probably lends to that belief.

name: Tri-threads
description:
A ball of yarn where every thread is actually three tight threads intertwined.
Can be woven into fabric.

name: Reinforced Fabric
description:
Any fabric woven of \item[87] will be super durable yet still very lightweight.
We are talking serious mid-to-late game material here!

name: Arachne Threads
description:
The thread from the anus of a spider. Yes, you read that right, anus.
Can be woven into fabric.

name: Spider Fabric
description:
No one talks about the source of this extremely sticky fabric-like material.
No one talks about why its sticky.

name: Iris Threads
description:
Truly radiant threads that... might actually just be RGB LED cables in disguise. TBD.
Can be woven into fabric.

name: RGB Fabric
description:
Exquisite materials for the avid gamer within.
The most headshot-ish gamer bling brand in the industry.

name: Nanowire
description:
It is cheating to call this "thread", because its extremely high-tech wiring.
Can be ...turned into "fabric", I guess.

name: Hypermesh
description:
Taking \item[93] and making "fabric" out of it results in this.
This is surreally durable and actually has negative weight.

name: Donabe
description:
The pinnacle of slow-cooking greatness in cuisines all over.
A tool used for stewing and simmering.

name: Pot
description:
It might actually be a cauldron, but the witch will never know.
A tool for boiling.

name: Wok
description:
A massive rounded metal bowl that can sustain high temps easily.
A tool for searing and frying.

name: Skillet
description:
A broad and somewhat shallow pan that cooks very evenly.
A tool for sauteing and wilting.

name: Hibachi
description:
A bucket with a grill slapped ontop of it.
A tool for grilling.

name: Obliterator
description:
A whirling blade that spins faster than you can even see.
A tool for blending and pureeing.

name: Cocotte
description:
A dome-shaped portable oven basically. Definitely safe in the bag.
A tool for baking and roasting.

name: Vaporera
description:
A large chamber between multiple layers that heats up water well.
A tool for steaming.

name: Caidao
description:
A massive over-sized cleaver of unknown origin.
A tool for chopping things up.

name: Icebox
description:
A huge icey container that is unclear in how it fits in your bag.
A tool for chilling and freezing.

name: Cross-pein
description:
A particular-shaped hammer that really makes you feel manly.
A tool for working metal.

name: Adze
description:
An ancient tool shaped unusually like a pickaxe kinda.
A tool for working wood.

name: Graver
description:
An effective and shapely carving instrument.
A tool for working gems.

name: Shears
description:
A massive set of scissors that are designed for cutting better than scissors.
A tool for working fabric.

name: Wirestrippers
description:
A pair of sharpen-edged blades for stripping wires and such.
A tool for working circuitry.

name: Alembic
description:
An extremely sophisticated device for distilling elements.
A tool for working catalysts.

name: Ukelele
description:
Play the ukelele vigorously and destroy things with the power of sound.
The ukelele can destroy certain stone spires.

name: Time Bomb
description:
An explosive that detonates after a few seconds.
Bombs can destroy walls that are already cracked.

name: Red Wand
description:
A magical wand with a flame on the tip that never goes out.
The flame isn't hot or even dangerous to humanoids, but it lights special torches just right!

name: Voltage Baton
description:
Delivers a sudden but short-lived massive burst of electricity.
Can overload nearby electronic devices and systems.

name: Providence
description:
A special feather bestowed upon you by the Trainer Lord.
Using this will instantly transport your party to his Lounge.

name: Snake Rope
description:
A nicely bundled rope that appears to be pulsing as though breathing...
Use this to get yourself across chasms and the like by striking specific targets.

name: Flux Drive: TBD
description: TBD

name: Flux Drive: TBD
description: TBD

name: Flux Drive: Crimson
note:
<hideFromJabsMenu>
found in a chest
in the first pass through
the salt mines
description:
A flux drive that is a deep ruby red, kinda like an 🍎.
Unlocks the "Bloody Exchange" difficulty layer.

name: Flux Drive: Saffron
note:
<hideFromJabsMenu>
found behind a bomb wall
in Lakeside Road
in the Meandering Way
description:
A flux drive that is a vibrant orange, like an 🍊.
Unlocks the "Omniplating" difficulty layer.

name: Flux Drive: Lemon
note:
<hideFromJabsMenu>
found in a chest
in the Highwater Way
in the Northern Way
description:
A flux drive that is shockingly yellow, similar to a 🍋.
Unlocks the "Glass House" difficulty layer.

name: Flux Drive: Viridian
description:
A flux drive that bears an unusual resemblence to the color of 🌳.
Unlocks the "Wild Overgrowth" difficulty layer.

name: Flux Drive: Aqua
description:
A flux drive that is bright like a rushing 🌊.
Unlocks the "Redirection of Flow" difficulty layer.

name: Flux Drive: Royal
description:
A flux drive of regal authority, flaunting its royal blueness like a 👑.
Unlocks the "Limitless Energy" difficulty layer.

name: Flux Threadbooster
description:
Increases the number of threads available to the spacial flux engine.
Increases \C[1]Max Layer Points by 5\C[0].

name: Recipe Scrap
description:
A scrap of a recipe.
Turn these in for recipes to Yelena.

name: Blueprint Scrap
description:
A scrap of a blueprint.
Turn these in for blueprints to Viskra.

name: Pattern Scrap
description:
A scrap of a pattern.
Turn these in for patterns to Millie.

name: Formula Scrap
description:
A scrap of a formula.
Turn these in for formulas to Alice.

name: Node Dust
description:
Faint glowing molecules that you breathed inadvertantly.
Grants \C[3]100\C[0] node points to each ally.

name: Node Microgems
description:
Microscopic crystals that you stepped on inadvertantly.
Grants \C[3]1000\C[0] node points to each ally.

name: Node Crystals
description:
Small crystaloids that you brushed against inadvertantly.
Grants \C[3]5000\C[0] node points to each ally.

name: Node Geode
description:
Sizeable glowing geode of crystals that you bumped into inadvertantly.
Grants \C[3]10000\C[0] node points to each ally.

name: Node Formations
description:
A collection of radiating geodes that you tripped over inadvertantly.
Grants \C[3]25000\C[0] node points to each ally.

name: Node Stalactites
description:
A giant mass of vibrant crystalline spires you hit your head on inadvertantly.
Grants \C[3]100000\C[0] node points to each ally.

name: Rouge Technodisk
description:
A reddish translucent and hyper-thin multi-part disk keycard that contains petabytes of encrypted information that open certain gates.
You found it in the Erocia Kingdom's Guard Office.

name: Bleu Technodisk
description:
A bluish translucent and hyper-thin multi-part disk keycard that contains petabytes of encrypted information that open certain gates.
This is not yet implemented.

name: Verte Technodisk
description:
A fragment of a greenish technodisk for opening gates.
This is not yet implemented.

name: RGB Technohypercube
description:
A cube of fissioned technodisks radiating colors that your eyes can't even perceive.
This is not yet implemented.

name: Is This Even Still A Potato
